losses.group_mass: Within each source/task, a_i=1/(G*n_i_component). Treat source-known and synthetic-known supervision separately in accounting.
losses.binary: Compute P_j=sumTRAIN a_i*m_ij*y_ij,N_j=sumTRAIN a_i*m_ij*(1-y_ij). q_j=min(5,max(1,sqrt(N_j/max(P_j,epsilon)))). If P_j=0 keep known-negative supervision with q_j=1 and mark positive-direction acceptance unsupported; if no known labels skip that head. No20-group gate. L_j=sum a*m*(q*y*softplus(-z)+(1-y)*softplus(z))/sum a*m*(q*y+1-y). L_domain=mean valid7,L_source=mean valid4. Unknowns exactly zero gradient.
losses.tau_self_supervision: Small dropout-view contrastive objective on actual officialTRAIN policy/spec text. Two encoder dropout views of the SAME source text are positives; mask same-document/same-scenario/alias components as negatives. No task-action targets or cross-document golden retrieval labels. At least2 distinct known roots in a contrastive batch, else skip that contrast term honestly. No permanent extra runtime head.
losses.total: L_domain +.25*L_source +.05*L_tau +.02*L_anchor. Normalize by known task mass within batch, not total dataset size; empty task loss0. Anchor=1-cosine(finetuned,frozen-base) on a fixed TRAIN-only policy/current-text subset to limit retrieval forgetting; reference model no gradients. Coefficients pinned, not selected on evaluation.
losses.batch_schedule: Deterministic epoch shuffles by canonical component and within-root chronology. Each step consumes up to32domain and32SGD examples when available; policy/spec batch16 every10steps. Do not duplicate small domains to fill indefinitely. Epoch ends when all fit-source rows consumed once; exhausted source contributes zero. Group weights and task normalization handle unequal source sizes. Any deliberate repetition has explicit maximum/count in manifest.
objective_gradient_checks: Known positive/negative finite-difference check per head
Unknown masks and tau domain/act masks have exactly zero corresponding supervised gradient
Same metadata/label mutation leaves tokenizer input identical
Current chronological prefixes unaffected by appended future turns
Encoder gradients nonzero and finite across all6layers; no accidental no_grad/detach
Each source has reported known/unknown/positive/negative and actual processed counts
losses.exposure_normalization: Before fitting compute K_s, the scheduled steps with known source/task supervision in one pass. Use K_total/K_s times the corresponding task loss so the epoch-integrated domain/source coefficients remain1/.25 despite exhausted sources; do not claim minibatch normalization alone balances source volume. Log actual effective weighted task mass, clipped-gradient frequency and source-specific loss. Freeze scheduling and these coefficients from TRAIN counts, never evaluation.
